lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-pyload-set-plugin-config-missing-admin-check
title: pyLoad API writes plugin config without an Admin role check
summary: 'The API''s config-setting method writes plugin options through `config.set_plugin` without checking
  the caller''s role. Any user holding the SETTINGS permission could therefore set security-critical plugin
  options, for example the AntiVirus `avfile` and `avargs` options, and so gain command execution. The
  role check that did exist covered only some core options, and it failed open when a `RuntimeError` was
  raised.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-269
- CWE-78
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1
  vulnerable_ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1^
  patched_ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1
  repository: https://github.com/pyload/pyload
rule:
  message: '`config.set_plugin` is called with a caller-controlled category/option/value and no preceding

    guard that returns early when the caller is not an admin. A non-admin user with SETTINGS permission

    can change sensitive plugin options (e.g. AntiVirus avfile/avargs), leading to command execution.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: self.pyload.config.set_plugin($C, $O, $V)
  - pattern-inside: "def $F(self, ...):\n    ...\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "if $COND:\n    ...\n    return\n...\nself.pyload.config.set_plugin($C, $O, $V)\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Before writing a plugin option, compare (category, option) against a set of admin-only plugin
    options

    (such as AntiVirus avfile and avargs) and refuse with an error log and return if the caller''s role
    is not

    Role.ADMIN. Determine the role once at the top of the method from flask.g.user_info, falling back
    to

    flask.session. Treat a call made outside a Flask request (internal use) as admin explicitly. Do not
    use a

    silent `except RuntimeError: pass` that skips the check.

    '
  example: "try:\n    try:\n        user_info = flask.g.user_info\n    except AttributeError:\n      \
    \  user_info = flask.session\nexcept RuntimeError:\n    user_info = {\"role\": Role.ADMIN}\nis_admin\
    \ = user_info.get(\"role\") == Role.ADMIN\n\nADMIN_ONLY_PLUGIN_OPTIONS = {(\"AntiVirus\", \"avfile\"\
    ), (\"AntiVirus\", \"avargs\")}\n\nelif section == \"plugin\":\n    if (category, option) in ADMIN_ONLY_PLUGIN_OPTIONS\
    \ and not is_admin:\n        self.pyload.log.error(\"requires Admin role\")\n        return\n    self.pyload.config.set_plugin(category,\
    \ option, value)\n"
